[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Holy damage]] | icon = Spiritbinder }} [[Decade Staff "Spirit's Absolution"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. == Stats == :[[Energy]] +10 :[[Holy damage|Holy Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Communing]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Restoration Magic]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]]) :Holy Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) :[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of spells during [[Special event|Festival events]]. (Chance: 20%) No effect in [[PvP]]. :Halves casting time of [[Divine Favor]] spells (Chance: 20%) :[[Divine Favor]]: 5 (if your rank is lower. No effect in PvP.) :{{gray|Two-handed}} :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== Uses the same skin as the [[Spiritbinder]] staff. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated for several reasons: *The universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons. *Except for an [[Hourglass Staff]] with a Restoration Magic requirement, there are no other [[ritualist]] staves that deal holy damage. *An [[Adept]] staff head on a ritualist staff would not affect Divine Favor spells. ==Notes== * Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). * Without attribute points invested in Divine Favor, the inherent Divine Favor from this weapon [[heal]]s [[ally|allies]] targeted by your [[monk]] [[spell]]s by 16. {{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this staff's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}} ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Staff]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]]
